problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:

* Package 1: weight 40kg, revenue 172 dollars
* Package 2: weight 38kg, revenue 189 dollars
* Package 3: weight 28kg, revenue 58 dollars
* Package 4: weight 48kg, revenue 71 dollars
* Package 5: weight 44kg, revenue 18 dollars
* Package 6: weight 10kg, revenue 282 dollars
* Package 7: weight 37kg, revenue 197 dollars
* Package 8: weight 16kg, revenue 22 dollars
* Package 9: weight 6kg, revenue 296 dollars
* Package 10: weight 7kg, revenue 167 dollars
* Package 11: weight 28kg, revenue 206 dollars
* Package 12: weight 19kg, revenue 174 dollars
* Package 13: weight 31kg, revenue 40 dollars
* Package 14: weight 49kg, revenue 130 dollars
* Package 15: weight 18kg, revenue 179 dollars
* Package 16: weight 27kg, revenue 177 dollars
* Package 17: weight 4kg, revenue 52 dollars
* Package 18: weight 5kg, revenue 30 dollars
* Package 19: weight 21kg, revenue 78 dollars
* Package 20: weight 48kg, revenue 36 dollars
* Package 21: weight 20kg, revenue 145 dollars
* Package 22: weight 39kg, revenue 124 dollars
* Package 23: weight 42kg, revenue 274 dollars
* Package 24: weight 21kg, revenue 293 dollars
* Package 25: weight 14kg, revenue 115 dollars
* Package 26: weight 9kg, revenue 239 dollars
* Package 27: weight 25kg, revenue 89 dollars
* Package 28: weight 6kg, revenue 145 dollars

The aircraft has a maximum cargo capacity of 489 kg. Determine which package combination will maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
